source.name: Sensaria GO checkout observations
source.note: Sensaria tax is account- and destination-specific. Do not infer it from the shipping zone alone.

policy.note: Only use a stored rate when it has been verified against Sensaria GO for the relevant destination/account. Otherwise require a manual tax-rate override and do not present after-tax profit as exact.

CA-BC.note: Verified on Sensaria GO checkout for a British Columbia destination: tax equals 5% of product plus shipping.
